Agent.description: A command-line coding agent the manager can install and run.

AgentStatus.description: One agent's install and sign-in state.

account.description: The signed-in account as the CLI reports it, absent when unknown.

available_update.description: A newer release than the installed version, absent when none is known.

config_disk_bytes.description: Bytes the agent keeps on /config, absent when they cannot be measured.

configured.description: Installed through the manager at least once.

oneOf.description: Present while an install or update is downloading.

installed_version.description: Absent when the agent is not installed.

oneOf.description: Present while a sign-in is waiting for the person signing in.

sign_in_ends_at.description: When the sign-in stops working unless the agent signs in again, absent when unknown.

CertificateStatus.description: The certificate the manager serves HTTPS with.

expires_at.description: When it expires, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

ClaudeOptions.description: A folder's own Claude Code options. Absent ones follow the Settings page.

capacity.description: The most sessions the folder's server runs at once, at least 1.

permission_mode.description: The permission mode for the folder's sessions.

spawn.description: Where new sessions work, always `same-dir` outside a repository.

ClaudeSettingsBody.description: How the manager installs, updates and serves Claude Code.

CloneRequest.description: A repository to clone into a new folder in /projects.

repository.description: A git URL or path, or `owner/repo` for GitHub.

serve.description: Whether the Claude app lists the folder, the "Serve new repositories" setting when absent.

CloneStatus.description: A clone that is running or failed.

error.description: Why the clone failed, absent while it runs.

name.description: The folder the repository goes into.

percent.description: How far the clone has got, from 0 to 100.

CommitIdentity.description: The name and email git writes into commits.

DownloadProgress.description: How far a download has got.

total_bytes.description: Size of the download in bytes, absent when the server does not say.

EnvironmentSettings.description: The container settings that come from its environment, read once at start.

port.description: `EZRA_PORT`, the port the manager listens on inside the container.

setup_scripts.description: Scripts in /etc/ezra/setup.d, run as root at every start.

tls_verification.description: `EZRA_TLS_VERIFY`, whether agent downloads check the server's certificate.

oneOf.description: Present when the folder is a git repository.

serve.description: Chosen to be served to the Claude app, by its own choice or by default.

FolderStatus.description: A folder with what the Claude app sees of it.

GitDetails.description: Where a repository comes from and what it has checked out.

branch.description: The checked-out branch, absent when not on a branch.

worktrees.description: Linked worktrees that still exist, counted on the main checkout only.

GitHubRepository.description: A GitHub repository the signed-in account can clone.

GitHubStatus.description: The GitHub sign-in git pushes with.

account.description: The GitHub account, absent when unknown.

failing.description: An account is set up, but GitHub did not confirm it.

from_environment.description: Comes from `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN`, so sign-in and sign-out return 409.

oneOf.description: Present while a sign-in waits for the person signing in.

GitStatus.description: The GitHub sign-in and commit identity git uses.

LoginPrompt.description: What the person signing in needs: a page to open, and sometimes a code to enter there.

code.description: The one-time code to enter on that page, when the sign-in uses one.

oneOf.description: Sent first on every connection, with the current revision.

ManagerEvent.description: One message on the event stream. Every change raises the revision by one.

ManagerStatus.description: The manager's own settings and state.

oneOf.description: Absent when the manager serves no certificate of its own.

PendingUpdate.description: A newer Claude Code a running server waits to restart on.

restart_by.description: When it restarts even with sessions running.

version.description: The installed version the server restarts on.

ReleaseChannel.description:
Which Claude Code releases to install: `latest` gets every release as soon as it ships,
`stable` is about a week behind and skips releases with major regressions.

RemoteControlOverview.description: Every Remote Control server, and where the Claude app lists them.

device.description: The device the Claude app lists the servers under, the container's hostname.

folders.description: The servers for folders in /projects, by folder name.

projects.description: The server for /projects, waiting when it has not started yet.

RemoteControlSettings.description: How Claude Code's Remote Control servers run.

capacity.description:
The most sessions each server runs at once, at least 1. Absent uses Claude Code's
default.

enabled.description: Serve /projects, and the folders chosen, to the Claude app while Claude Code is signed in.

permission_mode.description: The permission mode for sessions started from the Claude app, such as `auto`.

serve_repositories.description: Whether repositories that appear in /projects start with their switch on.

RemoteControlStatus.description: The manager's view of one Remote Control server.

last_error.description: The end of the server's output when it last stopped unexpectedly, until it connects again.

oneOf.description: What that output says went wrong, absent when it matches no known problem.

restarts.description: Unexpected stops since the manager started.

oneOf.description: A newer Claude Code the running server restarts on, absent when it runs the installed one.

url.description: Where to continue in a browser, once connected.

oneOf.description: What the server and its sessions use, absent while no server process runs.

ServeBody.description: Whether the Claude app lists a folder.

ServerLogTail.description: The end of a Remote Control server's log.

path.description: The whole log's path in the container.

ServerProblem.description: A known reason a server stopped.

ServerState.description: Where a Remote Control server is in its life.

ServerUsage.description: What a running server and its sessions use.

capacity.description: The most sessions the server runs at once, absent when Claude Code's default applies.

memory_bytes.description: Memory the server, its sessions and their commands use, with shared memory counted once.

authenticated.description: This request carries a signed-in session.

SpawnMode.description: Where sessions started from the Claude app work.

Topic.description: A part of what the web app shows.

UnsavedWork.description: Work in a repository that no remote has.

uncommitted_changes.description:
Changed and untracked paths in the folder and its worktrees, an untracked folder counting
once.

unpushed_commits.description: Commits on no remote, stashes left out.
